data.title: Mobile plan price increase to €22.99 from February 2026
data.summary: Muster Mobil GmbH wrote on 5 December 2025 that the monthly base price of the "Muster Allnet 10 GB" plan rises from €19.99 to €22.99 from 1 February 2026. You have a special right to cancel free of charge.
data.explanation: Your mobile provider is raising the monthly base price by €3.00. Because this change is not solely to your advantage, you have a special cancellation right (Sonderkündigungsrecht): you may cancel free of charge within three months of receiving the letter, and the contract ends at the earliest when the change takes effect. You can decide whether to accept the new price or cancel; the app shows until when you can cancel. Compare other providers before deciding. No payment or other action is required if you accept the change.
